audit.summary: Confirmed major: 2 Confirmed minor: 2 Core result refuted: False
limitations: P1 — Infinite-dimensional noise regularity does not transfer as asserted — Counterevidence: The product example is not falsely claimed to satisfy the impossible literal DLP-prime support clause. The eta1 example independently refutes the explicit p.29 implication. Bounded scalar paths in the spatial example satisfy the additional NS boundedness requirement. Rescaling amplitudes leaves coordinate-law distinguishability unchanged.

P2 — No common continuous-time compact invariant set under the stated window-energy bound — Counterevidence: The pointwise bound is explicitly called stronger on p.44 and is not assumed in Proposition 5.1. The claim quantifies over all real t>=0, not only aligned integer blocks. SE uses the proposed X circularly, but the example satisfies free stability on every bounded set.

P3 — Square-summable L2 basis coefficients do not imply bounded time paths — Counterevidence: The example concerns the actual basis/coefficient inputs, not the impossible literal global density-support clause. Navier-Stokes separately requires scalar paths bounded by one and excludes it.

P4 — Stationary solution need not have the strong-feeble property (4.11) — Counterevidence: The test is allowed to depend on k and the chosen past; there is no Lipschitz-constant bound in (4.11). The state process need not inherit the noise's SF. Synchronous coupling still gives exponential dual-Lipschitz contraction.
Limitations: No counterexample to Theorem3.4 with all its printed hypotheses is asserted.
Limitations: No proof that every affected PDE or the final integer-time ODE mixing conclusion is false.
Limitations: Literal infinite-dimensional DLP-prime support is impossible; product examples are not falsely claimed to satisfy that clause.
Limitations: Selected gluing dependency checked; other cited monographs and PDE regularity results not fully independently reproved.
Limitations: Exact author manuscript only; no VoR equivalence; no author code run or unseen supplement checked.

proposition.claim:
Summed L1 continuity of coordinate conditional densities does not give a common TV-Lipschitz bound; identical spatial copies need not preserve TV continuity; the literal compact support of a continuous finite-fiber density on all of infinite-dimensional E is impossible.

Proposition 5.1's compact set, invariant under every control satisfying (5.3) for every t>=0, need not exist.

The stated basis and coefficient hypotheses permit almost surely unbounded trajectories inside one unit block.

Uniform dual-Lipschitz trajectory convergence does not imply the supremum over all continuous tests bounded by one in (4.11).

repair.content:
Assume/prove SF directly for a narrower class or require a quantitative summed scaled coordinate TV-Lipschitz bound. Reformulate DLP-prime support in finite fibers while maintaining actual conditional measure support K. Identical nontrivial memory spatial products require a different noise class or a weaker-metric coupling.

Use aligned unit-block concatenation and BAS at budget 2M to construct an integer-time invariant set, rechecking compactness and LC; or impose a suitable pointwise forcing bound. Uniform attraction on a compact set should give GCP directly, not be identified with global norm contraction GD on all H.

Require sum c_l*||phi_l||_infinity finite or another justified bound on the random series.

Retain feeble/dual-Lipschitz mixing or prove additional state-space total-variation regularization.
